<subject>Draft of New Administration Transition Memo to Steve Kean</subject>
<body>
Steve,  

As we just discussed, attached is the transition memo recommending that you reach out to Clay Johnson. As highlighted in the memo, we are still coordinating with legal counsel to determine what leave status our employees must adopt while participating in both the private and publicly funded transition efforts. The resolution of this issue could influence their willingness to serve in certain cases.  
</body>
